note: White kit with a straight-on orthographic camera matching references/patek-nautilus-5711-1a (HALF the working scale: the 350 x 492 px JPEG is enlarged x4, working scale 26.5064 px/mm, so 13.2532 px/mm = 2 x the source scale; 1280 px square centred on the hand pivot (702.0, 853.0) of the x4 working image, i.e. the working image downscaled by 0.5 (INTER_AREA) has its pivot (351.0, 426.5) at (640, 640); the watch spans 30.2 mm above and 38.5 mm below the pivot, 20.9 mm to the left and 21.5 mm to the right (crown), so 1280 holds it with margin: 48.3 mm each way). The 5712/1A may reuse this preset only if its working scale and pivot agree within a pixel, else copy it with the new numbers. Same lighting as the Aquanaut, Audemars Piguet, Breitling and Tudor comparison kits. Comparison only, not the presentation look.
